segments.name: Fish Trading
segments.description: Trades fish, primarily eels, sourced and sold in Taiwan, arranging harvesting, inspection and delivery to customers.
segments.evidence: NTB engages in the trading of fish, primarily eels, in the Republic of Taiwan, or Taiwan.

segments.name: E-Commerce
segments.description: Acts as an agent facilitating sales of third-party products through live-streaming e-commerce platforms, earning commission.
segments.evidence: In the E-Commerce segment, we have focused on the United States, France, and the People's Republic of China, or China.

revenueModel.text: Customers buy fish and eels from the company; the company earns commission, recognized on a net basis, from facilitating third-party product sales on live-streaming platforms.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company does not take control of the goods sold, and commission revenue is recognized on a net basis.
